# Agent Python Tools

- repo: google-deepmind/actionengine
- repo_uri: https://github.com/google-deepmind/actionengine

## File: google-deepmind_actionengine/third_party/protobuf/python/docs/generate_docs.py

Prompts

```
['run generate_docs.py to create Sphinx RST reference files for all public protobuf modules', 'run find_modules to discover and filter public Python modules in the protobuf source tree', 'run write_automodule to generate a Sphinx automodule RST file for a given module name', 'run replace_toc to update index.rst with a new table of contents for all modules', 'review the INCLUDED_MODULES, IGNORED_PACKAGES, and IGNORED_MODULES tuples to adjust which modules get documentation']
```

Usage

```
{'run_generate_docs': 'run generate_docs.py to create Sphinx RST reference files for all public protobuf modules', 'run_find_modules': 'run find_modules to discover and filter public Python modules in the protobuf source tree', 'run_write_automodule': 'run write_automodule to generate a Sphinx automodule RST file for a given module name', 'run_replace_toc': 'run replace_toc to update index.rst with a new table of contents for all modules', 'review_ignore_config': 'review the INCLUDED_MODULES, IGNORED_PACKAGES, and IGNORED_MODULES tuples to adjust which modules get documentation'}
```
